# Gritsa Technologies

> Gritsa builds production AI for businesses: autonomous AI agents that automate whole job functions, Gen AI data pipelines that keep those agents fed with reliable data, and full-stack engineering that turns AI-built prototypes into products that scale. Founded in 2010, with teams in Noida (India) and London (UK).

Gritsa's agents are built on Jiva, an open-source (MIT) autonomous agent framework that works with any OpenAI-compatible model provider and connects to tools through MCP (Model Context Protocol). Gritsa's engineering approach is shaped by the problem it calls "catastrophic forgetting": AI-assisted code that loses coherence as a system grows.

## Services

- [Autonomous AI agents](https://gritsa.com/services/ai-agents/): agents that do real work in operations, supply chain, procurement, customer success and sales. Built on Jiva. Open source, no lock-in.
- [Gen AI data pipelines](https://gritsa.com/services/data-engineering/): self-healing data pipelines with schema change detection and the Write-Audit-Publish pattern, on Airflow or Dagster with Snowflake, Databricks or BigQuery.
- [Full-stack development](https://gritsa.com/services/fullstack-development/): Development-as-a-Service and Developer-as-a-Service teams that take Gen AI prototypes to production.

## Proof

- [Case studies](https://gritsa.com/projects/): healthcare finance analytics integrated with EPIC, Meditech and Cerner; AI for pharmaceutical supply chain risk using FDA and DailyMed data.
- [About Gritsa](https://gritsa.com/about/): the team and its history.
